vision_profile.embedded_sampler_note: Root header audit found selected GGUF metadata T1/top_p.95/top_k20, differing from the current publisher instruct recommendation T.7/top_p.95/top_k100. Apply the deliberate profile explicitly rather than assuming GGUF metadata matches current guidance.
vision_profile.memory_caveat: Combined files alone occupy 20.76GiB. 24GiB is a constrained experimental tier; 32GiB or host offloading is safer. The advertised 3GB phone operation uses LES expert streaming, special layer-wise quantization and DSpark on iPhone 17 Pro Max, not this ordinary Q4_K_M runtime.
vision_profile.architecture: MiniCPM-V 4.7: SigLIP visual encoder, early token compression and Qwen3.5 backbone with Canvas-MRoPE
vision_profile.reasoning_control: Selected root GGUF hard-disables reasoning in its embedded template. This is the publisher-recommended default because the checkpoint is not trained as a reasoning model. Optional thinking/ files carry the same tensors with a different template and emit [Start thinking] / [End thinking]; they are not needed.

image_budget.note: Keep 16x for a compact profile. Optional 4x mode produces four times the visual tokens despite its smaller projector file. Do not adopt 36 high-resolution slices by default on 2–4GB devices. Runtime-specific slice control must actually be wired before exposing it.

integration_notes: The official GGUF repository name ends in lowercase -gguf. Pair each language variant with its own matching projector; 1B and 35B projectors are different files/hashes.

Runtime source audit found MiniCPM-V4.7 support at b11551, already before the released xllamacpp b11870 snapshot. This establishes source support, not successful local inference with every quant/projector.
Root nonthinking and thinking/ weight files are alternative templates, not two required downloads. DSpark drafts are also optional and out of scope for baseline support.
The base card documents function schemas through the OpenAI-compatible tools API, and the upstream template serializes tools. Wrapper parsing still requires a live round-trip test.

In Transformers, downsample_mode must be passed to both apply_chat_template and generate. GGUF projector selection and runtime controls are different; do not copy a Transformers keyword into an inert config field.
Images/videos belong in user messages; the template rejects them in system messages.
